validator_prompt: Approve only if the report uniquely reconstructs the 100-pilot generation lineage from current artifacts and exact owners; quantitatively audits diversity, realism, data quality, jitter, duplication or degeneracy, validity, and candidate-family balance; links all related live GitHub issues and relevant repository configs/owners; separates implementation facts, artifact observations, inference, hypotheses, and primary-source literature claims; gives high-ROI changes plus bounded experiments with measurable pre-scale gates; states evidence gaps honestly; and makes no generator, config, thesis, Git, rollout, or GitHub mutation.
